title: The Twins
subtitle: Independent
description: Cousins to Jabba the Hutt, the Twins were a pair of fraternal Huttese siblings that wanted to take over their cousin's criminal empire after his passing. They arrived on Tatooine to do just that, but found themselves opposed by Boba Fett, who decided to fill that power vacuum himself. They traveled atop enormous litters and were quite a sight to behold wherever they went.
